create_app_state_reset: create an AppStateReset instance with an AppService and AppData to kick all users and restore session state
call_on_enter: call on_enter on AppStateReset to kick all connected users and transition the app state
call_get_next_state: call get_next_state on AppStateReset to return a lobby state when all users are disconnected

refactor_app_state_reset: refactor AppStateReset to customize the user kick behavior or add logging before transitioning to lobby
